description: This file defines the CountryCode validation rule class within the OrangeHRM system. The class extends AbstractRule and utilizes the CountryService to validate whether a given input string corresponds to a valid country code by checking for an associated Country entity.

classes.name: CountryCode
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given input is a valid country code by consulting the CountryService.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input string is a valid country code by retrieving the corresponding Country entity using the CountryService.
